# Configuration (#14)

Every key below is a default. Per-workflow override: append `.resident`, `.operator` or `.supervisor` to the key (the override wins).

```properties
# Generated by io.sajeev.policy.ConfigSnippet (#14). Defaults only; no value here is measured.
mosip.registration.liveness.policy.mode=HYBRID
mosip.registration.liveness.diagnostic.enabled=false
mosip.registration.liveness.active.challengeTimeoutMs=5000
mosip.registration.liveness.passive.voterWeights=equal
mosip.registration.liveness.active.challengeTypes=BLINK,SMILE,TURN_HEAD_LEFT,TURN_HEAD_RIGHT,LOOK_LEFT,LOOK_RIGHT,LOOK_UP,LOOK_DOWN,EYES_CLOSED_HOLD,OPEN_MOUTH
mosip.registration.liveness.metrics.enabled=true
mosip.registration.liveness.onEngineUnavailable=BLOCK
mosip.registration.liveness.binding.embedding.threshold=0.363
mosip.registration.liveness.active.minChallenges=2
mosip.registration.liveness.minFps=3.0
mosip.registration.liveness.enabled=true
mosip.registration.liveness.onRepeatedFailure=BLOCK
mosip.registration.liveness.binding.geometry.tolerance=calibrated-on-DEV
mosip.registration.liveness.frameProcessing=CONTINUOUS
mosip.registration.liveness.acceleration=AUTO
mosip.registration.liveness.binding.windowMarginMs=2000
mosip.registration.liveness.guidance.overrides=none
mosip.registration.liveness.maxRetries=3
mosip.registration.liveness.passive.threshold=0.80
mosip.registration.liveness.active.enabled=true
mosip.registration.liveness.passive.minLiveVotes=3
mosip.registration.liveness.model.manifest=models/manifest.json
```
